verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms docs.zapier.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of the developer documentation (SDK, MCP, integrations). An llms-full.txt is also served, doc pages are available as .md, and machine-readable OpenAPI specs plus an RFC 9727 API catalog are published for agents to consume. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents successfully using these docs, and a view of the full llms.txt contents beyond the probe excerpt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Local index for developer documentation: SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
